title: Disjoint Embedded Slots
statement: For natural numbers $a,b$, every $j\in\mathrm{Fin}(b)$ and $i\in\mathrm{Fin}(a)$ give distinct positions in $\mathrm{Fin}(a+b)$ when $j$ is embedded after the first $a$ positions and $i$ is embedded among the first $a$ positions.
replaced: For every right coordinate and left coordinate of a disjoint tape bank, the embedded right index is distinct from the embedded left index.
